title: Nick Gunner: Bridging technology and agriculture
note: On combining AI, remote sensing, and digital agriculture tools to help farmers build more resilient systems through crop diversification and polyculture research.

title: New app connects you with food from local farms
note: Television segment on Recipe Route's partnership with Fresh Fix, a USDA-certified food hub, to deliver local ingredients and recipes across Western New York. Reported by Kelly Dudzik.

title: WNY Startup – Recipe Route – “Helps Good Food Find You”
note: Feature on Recipe Route as a hyper-local food marketplace that matches seasonal recipes to nearby farm ingredients and delivers them through Fresh Fix.
